content.text: {"utterance":"My criterion now: someone has learned when they can use help well, meaning they predict, say which source they trust or doubt, and repair when that source is wrong or silent. Leonie, I'd resist \"storage\": a delayed test shows persistence, but not whether she can tell her notes are failing. Iris, your hundred-rices cook needs a source check too. The chatbot can locate a flaw in its own text, but conversation can't show whether it has any stake in the outcome. Unresolved: are predicting, locating and repairing one competence, or can someone have one without the others?","cites":["SA1","SA3"],"memory":"Claim: learning includes using help well: predicting, locating trusted or doubtful sources, repairing when help fails. Held against Leonie's storage framing. Open: are predicting, locating and repairing one competence or separable?"}
